summary: Kim Ha Thi Pham, 50, of Toronto, was found deceased near a ski trail at the Brainard Lake Recreation Area by a female passerby; she had been driving solo from Toronto toward California and had stopped to see scenery at Blue Lake.
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Coroner's Office
notes: Discovery date - actual date of death unknown. Snowmobiles used to recover and transport the body. Cause and manner of death still to be determined at publication; no foul play suspected.
